description: Publish your plan as a short ordered checklist the reviewers see live in the room, distilled from their feedback — one step per change you will make, each naming the annotation ids it answers. Replaces any list you set before. Tick steps off with marklayer_complete_next_step as you finish them, so the humans can watch the work land instead of asking where it is.

annotationIds.description: Ids of the annotations this step addresses.

text.description: The step, as an imperative: "Rename the CTA to Start trial".

name: marklayer_set_next_steps
